title: Counting Worksheets | Kindergarten Math Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: K.CC.A.2, K.CC.B.4, K.CC.B.5

Give your learners extra practice with Counting! This no-prep printable pack has 5 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (8 pages)

  • Count the Critters
  • Count the Ducks
  • Find the Group
  • What Comes Before?

  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Munch's Number Snack, Count the Critters, Count the Ducks, Find the Group, What Comes Before?), so children can play, then print and practice
